findings.source_quote: The Dayspring shineth from on high,
findings.suggested_fix: Preserve the poetic proper name and sense. Consider translating as: "הִדְּרִיחַ הַבֹּקֶר מִמַּעַל" or keep a more literal poetic rendering like "זריחת הימים זורחת מִמַּעַל" to reflect the original poetic title (Dayspring) shining from above.

findings.source_quote: His mercy reaches down to men-
findings.suggested_fix: Use a more natural Hebrew preposition and phrasing, e.g. "רחמיו יורדים אל־האדם" or "רחמיו יורדים אל־האנשים" instead of "יורדים לעבר האנשים"

findings.source_quote: Adore th’ almighty King of Kings!
findings.suggested_fix: Use a Hebrew verb that conveys worship/adoration rather than admiration. Suggested: "השתחוו בפני מלך המלכים האדיר!" or "הערצו" -> "השתחוו"/"העריצו" -> "עבדו" depending on intended tone. Retain worship sense.
